caption: AI Status
description: Container for agent-related scalar status attributes contributed by the ai_operation profile. Holds per-operation outcomes reported by the agent runtime — e.g. permission decisions, context-compaction reasons, sub-agent stop reasons — so they do not proliferate as discrete attributes at the event root. Attributes are added here as their taxonomies are defined; the high-frequency ai_stop_reason / ai_stop_reason_id pair remains at the profile root.
name: ai_status

permission_result_id.caption: Permission Result ID
permission_result_id.description: The normalized outcome of the agent runtime's permission check for this operation, as reported by the runtime. Normalized taxonomy to be defined.

compaction_reason_id.caption: Compaction Reason ID
compaction_reason_id.description: The normalized reason the agent runtime compacted context during this operation, as reported by the runtime. Normalized taxonomy to be defined.

subagent_stop_reason_id.caption: Sub-agent Stop Reason ID
subagent_stop_reason_id.description: The normalized reason a sub-agent spawned during this operation stopped, as reported by the runtime. Normalized taxonomy to be defined.
